BiblicalUsage: Sideros is iron itself, and it appears once, in the merchant's list of Babylon's cargo: gold and silver and precious stones, fine linen and purple and silk, wood and ivory and brass and iron and marble, all the wealth of a city that God will judge.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Babylon's iron is listed among its luxuries because even the hardest metal becomes merchandise when a city sells everything.
